closed.label: VALORANT is not running
closed.hint: Watching starts automatically when you launch it

starting.label: Connecting
starting.hint: Please wait until VALORANT finishes launching

menus.label: Waiting
menus.hint: We'll DM you when a match is found once you start matchmaking

queue.label: Matchmaking
queue.hint: You can wait here until it's found

bot.dmFailed: Failed to send DM. Have you user-installed Lapbot to your account? If not, add it from the button below.

login.title: Log in with Lapount
login.desc: Logging in sends DMs to your linked Discord.
login.requireDm: Log in with Lapount to receive DMs

setup.title: Log in with Lapount
setup.desc: Log in with your Lapount account to confirm where to send DMs.
setup.discordDesc: No Discord account is linked to Lapount. Link it, then press Confirm.
setup.testDesc: After adding Lapbot to your account, send a test DM to make sure it arrives. Once it does, setup is complete.

update.dialogDesc: Update to v{version} and restart the app.

share.title: Watch URL
share.warning: Anyone with the URL can see the player names in your current match. It won't appear in search.

noDiscord.title: No Discord is linked to Lapount. Linking it sends DMs when a match is found.
noDiscord.note: Changes take effect after you reopen the app.

account.botMissing: Lapbot hasn't been added to your account, so DMs won't arrive.
account.botAdd: To receive DMs, add Lapbot to your account.

settings.queueNotify: Also notify by DM when waiting starts
